Rabulpaila, Hangar
Brother, it's almost time.
...Stop calling me that while we're on duty.@How many times do I have to tell you?
Sorry. When it's just the two of us, it slips out.
It sets a bad example for the others.@Not that we'd ever be in the same unit@if things weren't like this.
I guess so...
So, by "almost time" you mean@the Head Officer's announcement?
Yes. Let's go to the briefing room.
Rabulpaila, Briefing Room
Herluga
Brethren of the Rabulpaila.@I must deliver some sorrowful news to you all.
It happened two days ago.@Our beloved Chieftain, His Excellency@Malum Quisude, collapsed from illness.
His Excellency suffered from a heart condition. I cannot@help but be moved that he hid it and endured such heavy@duties ever since our escape from planet Gadisword.
Fortunately, His Excellency survived...@but before losing consciousness,@he reportedly said this to his aides.
To keep the Rabulpaila from falling into the sun@and keep negotiating with the Earthlings as equals,@we must not create a political vacuum.
And so, he said, Herluga Isberga@is to be installed as acting Chieftain...
Hey, hey, is that for real...?!
Captain, is it true that His Excellency@had a heart condition?
...Yeah.
(That's strange...@It's different from what Fairy told me before...)
I shall respect His Excellency's wishes@and serve as his deputy@until he recovers.
Now, there is someone I'd like to introduce to you.@A hero who will bring us great fortune.
Gomoudokka
Hey, hello there.@My name is Gomoudokka Goraikunru...
From your point of view, I guess I'm a new alien.
In other words, I'm not an Earthling.@I came from the Zovorg... the Interstellar@Republic Federation.
The <Zovorg>?!@Aren't they the ones who attacked us@when that Earthling battleship came by?!
What is the meaning of this...?!
Silence, all of you.
But, Captain!
Shut up and listen, Sieg.
To us, Earth is an uncivilized backwater...@and Earthlings are savages with a strong fighting@spirit. Negotiating with them won't end well.
As the one entrusted with your fate, I judged that@we should seek the cooperation of the Zovorg,@an interstellar nation more civilized than Earth.
Our nation is used to contact@with races from other planets, you see.
With materials and technology from them, we can@repair the Rabulpaila's propulsion system and@space transfer device...
and escape the tragedy@of falling into the sun.
Besides, with us around, those guys who attacked@here before won't be able to lay a finger on you.
(So they're saying those were a different faction...@Then when and where did Head Officer Herluga@make contact with Gomoudokka?)
(His Excellency Chieftain Malum Quisude@was pushing peace talks with Earth...)
Space Beyond Lunar Orbit
Zeranio-class Carrier
Zeranio-class Carrier - Bridge
Iradoya
Gomoudokka contacted me just now.@He says the coup was a success.
Bilgo
Coup? Hardly. Lady Herluga is the one in charge@of the Rabulpaila's development... It's only right@that she become Supreme Head Officer.
But the Chieftain outranks her, right?
Malum was originally the Minister of Environmental@Development. He just got lucky fleeing to the Rabulpaila@and moved up the line of succession.
He managed to survive, but pushing@negotiations with Earth so hard@was where his luck ran out.
Now all that's left is to dispose of his bodyguard.
We're not going that far this time.@Have you pinpointed the Steel Dragons' location?
Yes. The Hagane and the Hiryu Custom@are anchored in separate places.
Aha, how lucky.@What are the chances the Ariard@is aboard one of them, I wonder?
After it was recovered, it was surely taken to Izu Base.@Since then, eight large ships able to carry it have left@the base, including the Hagane and the Hiryu Custom.
My, my, that'll be quite hard to pick right.@Those eight ships could have unloaded it somewhere@and had it moved somewhere else, too.
And it could've been snuck out by transport@vehicle or transport plane...@We haven't been able to check all of those, right?
...It is.
Besides, if the Siebe Drive isn't running,@we can't even detect it...
Even so, we must find it. Izu is poorly defended@right now. Shall we check there first?
I have a feeling it isn't there.@Especially since dear Bilgo attacked it before.
Then we'll go after the eight large ships that left Izu.
Well then,@let's narrow it down to the Hagane and Hiryu Custom.
On what grounds?
Woman's intuition.
Just kidding, kidding.@In a way, it's a safe hiding place.@They've got plenty of high-performance machines.
(That... does make some sense.)
Indonesia, Outskirts of Jakarta
Steel Dragons
Hagane: Bridge
Tetsuya
Commander, three hours have passed since we wiped@out the Lamaris. It seems Dr. Kobayashi's hypothesis@was correct.
Miles
That judgment will be made by the Joint Chiefs.
Even so, finding a way to wipe out the Lamaris...@to purify them... is a big step forward, I think.
It's not yet certain they've been completely purified.@If they feed on the miscellaneous thoughts that@linger in densely populated areas...
then as long as big cities and the people living in them@exist, the chance of them reappearing after a long time@is not zero.
Indeed. We know how to exterminate them, but for now@only we, with our T-LINK System and Sympathia units,@can actually do it.
And the Lamaris' origin is still unknown...@Don't forget the situation remains unpredictable.
...Sir.
I'll submit a report to the Joint Chiefs.@Move the ship outside the city and stand by@until ordered.
Roger.
Hagane - Private Quarters
So we decided to name the first <Mighty Walker>@prototype. My old man's idea is "Mogami No. 1"...@What do you think?
Fairy
...I'm not really sure.
No, no, it's lame.@There's not a shred of robot soul in it.
Robot... soul? What do you mean?
The burning justice and hot courage that dwell in a body@of steel... In other words, a Steel Spirit, super robot@spirit, super robot soul!
Saika
Is that why you named it the Soul Saber?
Yes, it means a sword of the soul to protect the Earth.@Is that weird?
No, not at all.
Geez, Akimi, all you talk about is the Soul Saber.@Isn't Fairy getting fed up?
Well, she said I could talk about anything...@Sorry, Fairy.
No, don't worry about it.@I enjoy listening to you talk.@It feels nostalgic, too...
Is that... because I remind you@of someone you know, after all?
Um... Let's stop here for today.
Aboard the Hagane
Thank you, both of you.
I don't know if that was any help, though...
Um... Can I ask you one thing?
What is it?
Why do we meet over a monitor@instead of in person?
...Those are the Doctor's instructions.
Is it like that when Jinpu meets her too?
...Yes.
Understood.
(Fairy's name was in the employee directory,@so it seems true that she works for our company...@but it's still suspicious.)
Well then, I'll ask you again sometime.@I'll let you know.
Okay. See you.
...I see. She's sharp, that one.
I couldn't exactly tell her we need a translator,@so I managed to dodge the question for now, but...
If we had them meet with a translator attached,@they might figure out who Fairy really is.@What about the employee directory?
I talked with Mr. Kawanishi. It's been taken care of.
Did Akemi access it?
Yes, sir.
If she looked into it before asking you,@then her suspicions haven't been cleared.
Yes. I think it'll be hard to keep hiding it like this.
They may be orders from above, but to an outsider,@there's no denying the way Fairy's being handled@is a stretch.
Wouldn't it be better to tell those two@the truth?
You're right... If Fairy's memory recovery isn't@making progress, we'll have to think of something else.@I'll take it up with the higher-ups myself.
Hagane - Hangar
Jinpu
Doc, I started the main engine.
Eric
Then I'll begin taking data.
It reacted during the Lamaris extermination op@in Jakarta too. Can't we call it confirmed?
No, I don't think so.
Then what about it being a telekinesis-related system,@since the Lamaris seem to react to that?
Then we'd have gotten results sooner.@Both Izu Base and this ship have <Telekinetic> pilots@and the <T-LINK System> close at hand.
Yeah, that's true.
To begin with,@even if it's a system that reacts to the Lamaris,@I can't see what it would be used for.
Those things pop up over time in places@the Steel Dragons haven't been, right?@Couldn't it be for converting them into energy?
That'd be limited by place and time. Inefficient.
Then what the hell is it?
I think it's just reacting to something@that resembles something the Lamaris give off.
...So the real target exists somewhere else, huh?
Mm-hm. This is just my hunch, but I think@the black box is a system for absorbing@or converting some kind of huge energy.
Like the Compatible Kaiser's OG Engine,@or the Garmraid and Cerberus's TE Engines?
Mm-hmm.
Then how do we find the real target?
For now, I'll try starting up the Drift Wing's@main engine in all sorts of situations.
I see, so that's what this test is about.
Well, if Fairy gets her memory back...
Eita
Gravity quake reading detected!@One o'clock, elevation 30, Range 5!
All hands, level-one battle stations.@Launch mobile units.
Roger!
It looks like it'll transfer in any moment!
So they're aiming for an area with@no friendly units deployed...!
If they're transferring here at this timing,@their target must be this ship.
Transfer complete! One contact!@Identification... Zeranio-class!
(The Golaikunru. Then their objective is...)
Enemy units launched from the Zeranio-class@are approaching! Straight from one o'clock!@Entering Range 3 shortly!
All mobile units, launch!
Unlike last time, they don't seem to be@controlled by the Madnet.
Roa
Yeah.
(...Not the Fury again.@I don't need the time to think@he talked about anymore.)
There's a Raig-Geios among the enemy.@There may be a human commander aboard it.
Then let's teach them their business@with us won't go well.
Business?
Yes, those guys... the Golaikunru are war merchants.@They're interested in the Steel Dragons'@special machines.
Especially the new Gespenst Haken@and that cute partner of yours. They'd probably@figure those would sell for a lot.
I see. That's business, all right.@...Aschen, thanks for everything all this time.
Aschen
I'll be kicking them away before they sell me away.
Well, well, time to test my luck.@Is what I'm after on that ship or not...@Let's start with round one.
Bilgo dear,@I'm sending the Garoika at the Hagane.
Understood.
(This woman has no sense of tension...@A commander should be gallant,@like Lady Reggiane.)
...Gilliam, private channel.
Go ahead.
Do you think they're after the Drift Wing?
It's hard to imagine they've detected it...@but there's a good chance they came to probe.
Got it.
Eleve 1 to all units.@Don't let the enemy... especially the Garoika@get close. Destroy them as top priority.
...! This data...!
Oh my?@Could it be we've actually hit the jackpot?
Yes, it's a Siebe Drive reading...!@No doubt about it. The Ariard is inside the Hagane.
Aha, coincidences like this really do happen.@Maybe, just maybe, it's because unlucky@little Kinaha isn't here?
Send reinforcements at once!
Easy, easy.@This mission's over now. We're pulling out.
What are you saying?! Now's our chance to retake@the Ariard, and if we can't...
we destroy it!
Hello? We want that thing too, you know?
Better to destroy it than let the Earthlings analyze it!@Gadisword's future hangs@on the Siebe Drive!
(Well, Bilgo can't do it alone anyway...@and there are new faces among the enemy,@so I guess I can play along a bit longer.)
Nngh! With the Siebe Drive right before my eyes!
Okay, that's enough, that's enough.@Would you rather die here, or get scolded@by Reggiane? Which is it?
Ugh.......... Withdrawing.
Oh, how obedient.@Well, with your machine in that state...
Well, well... Maybe I'll stay a little longer@and gather data on the new faces.
...The Steel Dragons sure are tough.@Well, at least I got lucky and found out@where the Ariard is.
Wait, just a little more...!
I'll leave you behind, okay?@Want to get careless and captured@and ruin everything?
Ugh... F-Fine.
Well then, see ya later~
All enemy signals in the combat area have vanished!
This ship will hold at <TD Hovering> at its current@position. Maintain strict all-around watch.
That Raig-Geios looks like the same one@that attacked us at the Rabulpaila.
It's just a side trip, but@I'm going to have a little fun.
Hmm, this feeling...@Haven't we met somewhere before?@It's kind of bugging me.
(My, my, did she notice?@Even so, I won't be answering.)
Mmm, looks like I got turned down, but@is that a yes or is it being ignored? Which is it?
I recognize that Raig-Geios's maneuvers...!
Tsugumi
Yes, the thruster firing intervals are similar@to the machine that attacked the Rabulpaila.
(That machine looks like it'd sell for a lot,@so I'd like to get it undamaged if I can.)
Those movements... There's a person aboard. Then!
Oh my?
Raig-Geios pilot!@You are acting against the Privy Council's decision!@Cease combat at once and disarm yourself!
(That voice... It's that Gayattoba Stecca Kinaha@talked about, was it? I've run into@kind of a pain in the neck.)
(My, my, you move pretty well, don't you?)
(Those movements, always holding back a step...@It resembles the machine that attacked us@at the Rabulpaila.)
No doubt about it, it's the one from That Time...@the Raig-Geios that attacked the Rabulpaila!
(Just what you'd expect from the Steel Dragons...@Full of talented people. I'd love to scout them.)
Hagane - Hangar
Those fellows just now moved oddly.@Sänger, what do you make of it?
They made a show of targeting the Hagane,@yet had no will to push through... Half-hearted foes.
We have more new faces now, like the Bellzelute,@Granteed and Gespenst Haken, so maybe it was@a reconnaissance in force?
Even so, they had few troops.@The Golaikunru should know our strength well.
So, just feeling us out for now?
I don't see why they'd need@to do that at this point.
Um... Major Kai made a point of saying not to let@the Garoika get near the Hagane, right?@Why is that?
That machine carries high-performance sensors and@is also used for reconnaissance... I think it was@to keep the enemy from probing the Hagane.
Then perhaps what those fellows were after wasn't the@machines outside, but something inside this ship.@Does anything come to mind?
Hmm... Nothing right off the bat.
It's also possible it's something@those of us here don't know about.
Do you have something in mind?
Ah, no...
(Maybe it's something inside that hangar@Jinpu goes to all the time...)
(Nah, that's totally out of nowhere.)
Hagane - Briefing Room
According to Mr. Kawanishi's report,@they activated the Drift Wing right before@the battle just now.
Surely that's not why@the Golaikunru attacked.
He says they learned of the enemy attack about three@minutes after firing up the engine... Given everything@so far, I think that's unlikely.
However, they may now know@the Drift Wing is on the Hagane.
That's exactly what we intended...@How was Fairy Cribia?
According to Lieutenant Saika Shinagawa's report,@she showed nothing unusual.
In other words, no progress.
On that matter, there's something I'd like@to propose myself later.
Understood.
...Still, I wonder if the Golaikunru had@a pretty good guess when they went@after the Hagane.
They most likely knew the Drift Wing was@brought to Izu Base, but...
after that, tracking it would be hard unless they sent@spies into the base or turned someone on the inside.
Someone on the inside...
The most suspicious one has amnesia@and is under watch.
Maybe the enemy commander is good@and is reading our intentions.
(...Or is it just plain luck?)
